component.name: Nirava
component.summary: Manage settings and software on your Wayland desktop

description.p: Nirava is a native settings application for Niri and Hyprland, built with Rust, GTK 4 and libadwaita.
Inspect displays, sound, power and installed software. Review package actions before using your existing package manager.

This is a development preview. Desktop writes are disabled by default. The Flatpak frontend requires a separately installed native companion for host discovery; app launching and package terminal handoff are available in the native build.
